say:0:1511482001:1.text: The blood-red spear stands silently, but both you and Nazrik feel the change. It's no longer what it once was.
say:0:1511482001:1.source_cn: 血色长矛静静伫立，你和那非都能感受到，它们已和从前不同。
say:0:1511482001:1.male: The blood-red spear stands silently, but both you and Nazrik feel the change. It's no longer what it once was.
say:0:1511482001:1.female: The blood-red spear stands silently, but both you and Nazrik feel the change. It's no longer what it once was.

say:2:1511482002:1.text: For Dunn. For every fallen warrior.
say:2:1511482002:1.source_cn: 为了顿，为了死去的战士……

say:3:1511482003:1.text: For the future you promised—the fall of the goddess.
say:3:1511482003:1.source_cn: 为了你许诺的……神陨的未来。
say:3:1511482003:1.male: For the future you promised—the fall of the goddess.
say:3:1511482003:1.female: For the future you promised—the fall of the goddess.

cinematic_dialogue:7:1511482101:.text: This is no divine gift. This is blood debt.

say:9:1511483001:1.source_cn: 我忽然有种不安的感觉……

say:10:1511483002:1.text: You're... you're about to leave, aren't you?
say:10:1511483002:1.male: You're... you're about to leave, aren't you?
say:10:1511483002:1.female: You're... you're about to leave, aren't you?

choice_prompt:11:1511483002.text: You're... you're about to leave, aren't you?
choice_prompt:11:1511483002.male: You're... you're about to leave, aren't you?
choice_prompt:11:1511483002.female: You're... you're about to leave, aren't you?

say:13:1511483005:1.text: You appeared so suddenly. I knew you'd vanish the same. I was prepared.
say:13:1511483005:1.source_cn: 你出现得太突然，离开时恐怕也一样。我早就做好准备了。
say:13:1511483005:1.male: You appeared so suddenly. I knew you'd vanish the same. I was prepared.
say:13:1511483005:1.female: You appeared so suddenly. I knew you'd vanish the same. I was prepared.

say:14:1511483006:1.text: Somehow... I always knew this farewell was waiting, as if it were already written in my memories.
say:14:1511483006:1.source_cn: 不知道为什么，我好像很早就预料到了这场告别，就像它本就...
say:14:1511483006:1.male: Somehow... I always knew this farewell was waiting, as if it were already written in my memories.
say:14:1511483006:1.female: Somehow... I always knew this farewell was waiting, as if it were already written in my memories.

say:15:1511483007:1.text: "Because this is only a dream"—you bite back the words. Yet the dream feels so real, it's almost impossible to tell.
say:15:1511483007:1.source_cn: 因为这只是一场梦——你没有将这句话说出口。这场梦已经真...
say:15:1511483007:1.male: "Because this is only a dream"—you bite back the words. Yet the dream feels so real, it's almost impossible to tell.
say:15:1511483007:1.female: "Because this is only a dream"—you bite back the words. Yet the dream feels so real, it's almost impossible to tell.

say:16:1511483008:1.source_cn: 以后，你还会再次出现吗？

choice_prompt:17:1511483008.source_cn: 以后，你还会再次出现吗？

say:19:1511483010:1.text: Then I'll wait. No matter how long it takes. Even if the chance never comes.
say:19:1511483010:1.source_cn: 我会等你。无论有没有机会，要等到什么时候。
say:19:1511483010:1.male: Then I'll wait. No matter how long it takes. Even if the chance never comes.
say:19:1511483010:1.female: Then I'll wait. No matter how long it takes. Even if the chance never comes.

choice_prompt:20:1511483010.text: Then I'll wait. No matter how long it takes. Even if the chance never comes.
choice_prompt:20:1511483010.source_cn: 我会等你。无论有没有机会，要等到什么时候。
choice_prompt:20:1511483010.male: Then I'll wait. No matter how long it takes. Even if the chance never comes.
choice_prompt:20:1511483010.female: Then I'll wait. No matter how long it takes. Even if the chance never comes.

choice:20:1:2.text: I swear it. The Hunting Goddess will fall.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 我保证，狩猎神一定会陨落
choice:20:1:2.male: I swear it. The Hunting Goddess will fall.
choice:20:1:2.female: I swear it. The Hunting Goddess will fall.

choice:20:2:3.text: Hide your intent. Don't let anyone know.
choice:20:2:3.source_cn: 伪装好自己，别让别人看出你想弑神
choice:20:2:3.male: Hide your intent. Don't let anyone know.
choice:20:2:3.female: Hide your intent. Don't let anyone know.

choice:17:1:2.text: I think... this is goodbye for good.
choice:17:1:2.male: I think... this is goodbye for good.
choice:17:1:2.female: I think... this is goodbye for good.

choice:17:2:3.text: Your other soul won't appear again.
choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 你的“另一个灵魂”不会再出现了
choice:17:2:3.male: Your other soul won't appear again.
choice:17:2:3.female: Your other soul won't appear again.

say:27:1511483004:0.text: As we should. You are my other soul.
say:27:1511483004:0.source_cn: 本该如此。你是我的另一个灵魂。
say:27:1511483004:0.male: As we should. You are my other soul.
say:27:1511483004:0.female: As we should. You are my other soul.

choice:11:1:2.text: Seems we understand each other more than I thought.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 看来我们真的有些默契了
choice:11:1:2.male: Seems we understand each other more than I thought.
choice:11:1:2.female: Seems we understand each other more than I thought.

choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 你居然这么淡定地接受了这件事？

narration:28:15014018:0.text: Reassured by your promise, Nazrik comes to terms with himself and draws his spear with resolve. At the same time, the rift out of the dreamscape opens.
narration:28:15014018:0.source_cn: 听过你的许诺后，那非解开了心结，毅然拔出了神赐长矛。与...
narration:28:15014018:0.male: Reassured by your promise, Nazrik comes to terms with himself and draws his spear with resolve. At the same time, the rift out of the dreamscape opens.
narration:28:15014018:0.female: Reassured by your promise, Nazrik comes to terms with himself and draws his spear with resolve. At the same time, the rift out of the dreamscape opens.
